    Abu Dhabi is considered to have one of the best healthcare systems in the world. As a result, many healthcare professionals around the globe want to be part of it. However, those professionals who are planning to run a medical practice in Abu Dhabi must first acquire a HAAD Medical License, which enables them to do their job.

    In this article, you will learn everything you need to know about HAAD medical licenses in Abu Dhabi and how to get it. New medical centers and hospitals are being built in areas that most need them. Therefore, there are plenty of job opportunities for individuals looking for job opportunities in this emirate. Let us see:

    1. What is the HAAD License?

    The HAAD License is a document that offers licensure for medical professionals like doctors, nurses, and pharmacists to work in the UAE. Therefore, they have to obtain a license from the appropriate government body, which is the Health Authority of Abu Dhabi (HAAD). In addition, they will categorize the applicants in a particular profession and ask them to take the HAAD Exam. It is valid for 5 years from the date of passing the exam.

    Law 13 founded the Abu Dhabi Health Authority in June 2007 intending to create a strategic health authority for the Emirate of Abu Dhabi to set policies and strategies for health and to assure their application of them.

    2. What are some of the requirements for a HAAD License?

    Firstly, the first requirement from the Health Authority- of Abu Dhabi is that you must legally translate all of your documents into English. Next, we will see a list of some of the required documents. Let us see:

    • Valid copy of passport
    • Experience certificates
    • Educational qualifications
    • Valid Health Professional license (issued by relevant authority)
    • Good Standing certificate (issued by relevant regulatory authorities)
    • Nomination letter (applicants sponsored by facilities)
    • Form of staff data clearance

    There are more required documents to apply, but do not worry; we can give you the full list and advise you during the entire application process in case you need our assistance.

    However, it is important to stand out that it is unable to deliver HAAD license requirements in the following countries: Canada, France, Greece, Ireland, and South Africa. You can also check our post about getting the DED license in the UAE.

    3. Things you need to know before getting the HAAD License

    Some health care professionals are exempt from taking the HAAD exam. In addition, those who are over the age of 60 are required to take annual Medical Fitness Examinations from SEHA facilities.

    If the person is acquiring the HAAD for the first time must pay exam and license fees. Nevertheless, in the case of exams fees, these can vary depending on the type of exams applied for while the licensing fees differ according to the field of specialization. Here can see a list of HAAD license fees according to different medical practices:

    • Pharmacist Tech license fees (AED 150)
    • Nurse license fees (AED 300)
    • Physicians license fees (AED 2,600)
    • Pharmacist license fees (AED 300)

    On the other hand, those who successfully acquired their HAAD medical license have to renew it after 5 years, starting from the time of passing the exam. However, before renewing it applicants may have to send documents or pass certain exams. As a result, the sponsoring healthcare facilities may request healthcare professionals to apply for license renewals.

    Within the renewal process, there are certain documents applicants must provide:

    • Valid passport
    • Constant medical education
    • Malpractice insurance
    • Family Book
    • UAE identification card

    Regarding the fees, license renewals also require the following charges:

    3.1 Pharmacy Technicians

    • Fee for One-year renewal (AED 100)
    • Fee for Two-year renewal (AED 100)
    • Penalties per month (AED 37)

    3.2 Pharmacists

    • Fee for One-year renewal (AED 200)
    • Fee for Two-year renewal (AED 300)
    • Penalties per month (AED 50)

    3.3 Nursing

    • Fee for One-year renewal (AED 200)
    • Fee for Two-year renewal (AED 300)
    • Penalties per month (AED 50)

    3.4 Technicians

    • Fee for One-year renewal (AED 200)
    • Fee for Two-year renewal (AED 300)
    • Penalties per month (AED 50)

    3.5 Physicians

    • Fee for One-year renewal (AED 850)
    • Fee for Two-year renewal (AED 1,600)
    • Penalties per month (AED 625)

    It is crucial to highlight that those who do not renew their licenses within 6 months of their expiry dates will suffer cancellation by the law. In addition, applicants who do not renew their licenses before the scheduled expiration will incur penalties.

    That was the short explanation of the HAAD medical license and its renewal in Abu Dhabi. Below, we will take a look at the health care system in Abu Dhabi

    4. Why should you acquire a HAAD Medical License?

    As a matter of fact, there is a great demand for healthcare professionals in Abu Dhabi. This is due to the fact that the UAE has over 40 public hospitals. As a result, the Ministry of Health is expanding health facilities and hospitals in all the emirates, especially in Abu Dhabi.

    Consequently, it is the reason why there is a high demand for GP jobs that need filling. Thus, having this professional license will provide many advantages and privileges to physicians such as:

    4.1 Ensure quality assurance

    It provides quality assurance in the healthcare field and helps to ensure that the standards of quality in the medical community are consistently met for the sake of patients.

    4.2 Prevent losing revenues

    It can contribute to preventing medical practices from losing thousands of dollars in lost revenue from delayed or denied reimbursements. If a medical practice allows a physician to deliver services during the credentialing process, the insurance payer may be able to backdate the reimbursement to cover the treatments.

    4.3 Keep patient safety

    This ensures practices and physicians have the experience and skills necessary to perform procedures on patients. In addition, it contributes to reducing the risk of medical errors caused by incompetent providers.

    4.4 Improves physician reputation

    Nowadays, patients are researching healthcare practices and their physicians before committing to them. When patients search for a physician’s medical practice, they want to make sure their practices are reputable and they can trust them.

    5. How is the healthcare system in Abu Dhabi?

    The UAE is comprised of a national health service, which is overseen by the Ministry of Health and Prevention.  However, Abu Dhabi has its own health authority, which is as we already know, the Health Authority Abu Dhabi (HAAD).

    Most hospitals are private, offering a range of inpatient care (where hospital admission provides treatment) and outpatient (where treatment is administered without requiring hospital admission) clinics. In addition, there are many available pharmacies in Abu Dhabi.

    The health care system complies with international standards thanks to modern medical technology. Therefore, there are many ex-pats working in the health sector.

    5.2 Before traveling to the UAE

    Before you make the decision to travel to Abu Dhabi, you need to undergo a full medical examination and have any necessary vaccinations before flying to the United Arab Emirates. A medical certificate may be required depending on the country you are flying from. You will need to vaccinate against hepatitis A and B, typhoid, diphtheria, tetanus, polio, and rabies.

    Also, it is crucial that you undergo a medical examination once you are in the United Arab Emirates as part of your application. Your spouse and dependents joining you are also required to follow the same procedures. Anyone who tests positive for HIV, hepatitis B, or tuberculosis will be denied a visa.

    6. What are some of the health care strategies, policies, and laws in the UAE?

    The United Arab Emirates laws guarantee the best and the most professional healthcare services while ensuring rights to patients. Many sectors such as medical care medication, medical facilities, and others have been developed to complement the law, offering a holistic approach to healthcare services in the UAE.

    Currently, the government is working in collaboration with all health authorities in the country to have all public and private hospitals. This way, it is accredited according to clear national and international quality standards of medical services and staff.

    In addition, they emphasize the importance of preventive medicine and seek to reduce cancer and lifestyle-related diseases such as diabetes and cardiovascular diseases to ensure a longer, healthy life for citizens. Moreover, the government wants aims to reduce the prevalence of smoking and increase the healthcare system’s readiness to deal with epidemics and health risks.

    In order to achieve all these goals, the United Arab Emirate government is improving its ranking in 11 indices relating to healthcare and protection. To sum up, it is a rapidly developing private health sector that delivers a high standard of health care to the population.

    7. Advantages of working in the healthcare field in Abu Dhabi

    The opportunities to work as a professional in Abu Dhabi are considerable and it is a prestigious place to practice as a medical professional. One of the most attractive advantages is the salary and benefits. However, this one will depend on your specialty and how many years of experience you have. It can vary from 25k AED a month up to 400k AED.

    Additionally, your income is tax-free in the UAE, which is why it is attractive to ex-pats. Also, numerous healthcare positions include benefits such as paid annual leave for up to 40 days for full-time staff, health insurance, and travel expenses.

    If you want to get into the business of consultancy, then getting a consultancy license in Dubai has to be your first step. This shows that your project can be helpful for the city.

    If you are serious about getting a consultancy license in Dubai, then you will have to begin the process of getting licensed by Dubai authorities. In this guide, we will teach you how to accomplish that goal.

    1. How can you define your business activity?

    Starting a business is relatively easy, but obtaining a consultancy license in Dubai is not always simple. One of the essential things you have to do before starting a partnership is to define your business activity. There are many categories in which you can create your business, so which one is right for you?

    Your choice will depend on your skills, resources, and location. If you are unsure about which category to choose, contact the Dubai Economic Department for more details.

    2. Do you have to register your company’s name to get a license?

    All new businesses in Dubai, even if they are digital organizations, are required to register the name of their company with the Commercial Registration and Licensing Department. An individual can start a business as a sole owner or a limited liability company.

    The process for obtaining a consultancy license in Dubai is quite different from getting other licenses. consultancy license in Dubai require confirming that the consultant is competent, has an adequate office infrastructure, and has appropriate supervision.

    3. How can you create a solid structure for your company?

    Offshore companies need to have a solid structure before applying for a consultancy license in Dubai. This will help you establish your company in dubai and keep it up to date with the latest regulations.

    3.1 Think about the future of your project

    If you are the owner of a project, it is essential to think about your company’s future. You need to know the trends and Business Setup in Dubai Mainland . You should also think about whether you have a succession plan or who will take over the company once you retire.

    The best way to ensure that your business is successful in the future is to think about where it is going now. Whether you are starting an organization or running one for a long time, you should do this.

    3.2 Focus on the results

    The team needs to have a balance. For example, one person can be in charge of creating content, and another can edit it. Teams should also create a system for communicating with each other and prioritizing.

    You can do many things to make departments and teams work better together. In other words, communication is vital. It is essential to stay informed about what is going on inside and outside your department. This will ensure you can provide valuable input in meetings.

    3.3 Create a plan

    Your organizational structure is essential for your company. It will keep your business running and minimize the chaos resulting from a lack of organization. As an entrepreneur, you may not be thinking about this too much as you get up and running, but it is essential to think about it now to save yourself future troubles.

    You have to figure out what areas of your business need to be organized the most. Then, you can start breaking down each area into different departments, like marketing or customer service. Make sure to have a department for each type of activity.

    3.4 Find the right employees

    It is common knowledge that, in order to be successful, you need to find the right people. What is challenging is knowing who you should be looking for.

    One of the first things to consider when searching for people is their passion and how it matches your company’s vision. The next factor to consider is their level of expertise and how it can improve your team. Finally, make sure that they have the necessary skill set for what you need them to do.

    3.5 Find people willing to be disciplined

    You need to give responsibilities to your workers. This means that you should allow them to make decisions and be responsible for their work. It also means that they will have the authority to make crucial decisions without your involvement, but they will have to face the consequences of their choices.

    It is essential to give your employees as much responsibility as possible to feel like part of the team. When people think that they are part of a team, they are more motivated, increasing productivity.

    An alternative to the annual review is conducting continual feedback throughout the year. It is more regular, and you can evaluate employees with real-time feedback.

    4. How can you choose the location of your business?

    You need to select a location to have your consultancy license in Dubai. If you are considering opening a business and need to decide which place is best for it, think about these factors:

    • Local business climate
    • Population density
    • Target customer base
    • Rent and property prices
    • Ease of access
    • Crime rates
    • Nearby schools and colleges

    The Department of Economic Development is the government agency responsible for business licensing in Dubai. If you are a resident and would like to have a consultancy license in Dubai, you must apply for a license.

    Once you have a Trade license in Dubai, there are additional requirements that you must comply with before starting your business in Dubai. These are the documents you need to provide to have your consultancy license.

    • A united number
    • A No Objection Certificate
    • At least two approvals from the government
    • Two photos in passport size
    • Two copies of your visa and your passport

    6. Is it possible to obtain approval from the government?

    If you are interested in starting your consultancy, you will need to consider the necessary approvals and processes to be completed before you can get started. The first step would be to ensure that you have the qualifications required for a consulting license.

    You will also need to obtain a general business trade license in dubai and a permit to practice law. It is better to have everything finished before you can start your consultancy. You will also require an address where registered agents can be contacted if there is any correspondence.

    7. Do you need a bank account to have your consultancy license in Dubai?

    In Dubai, the Corporate Account is a mandatory requirement for any business operating as a consultancy firm. Without this, your consultancy license will not be issued.

    A corporate bank account is needed to open an account with a consultancy license in Dubai. This is because the account will store the company’s funds generated through the services provided. This will also provide the necessary security for the funds and the business.

    8. Why do companies hire consulting services?

    Consultants are an excellent investment for startup companies. They can guide in areas of need and complete the planning for a company.

    A new company to the world of business would benefit from consulting services because they will have all the knowledge necessary to get a strong start. Consultants can help with market research, branding, logo design, and many more things that startups may not know about.

    8.2 To gain new perspectives

    A consultant’s value is often unappreciated initially, and they are most easily hired when the company is struggling. A company can benefit from the suggestions of a consultant to explore new opportunities or to revisit old projects.

    Someone with relevant experience can provide a fresh perspective to help a company’s business goals. Their new perspective can also be beneficial in making adjustments to long-standing projects or personnel.

    The best consultants know about the industry and know the individuals responsible for the company’s success. Therefore, they will find opportunities to improve operations, increase profits, or make changes to stay competitive.

    8.3 To create new projects you need a consultancy license in Dubai

    Companies are looking for ways to grow and evolve, but this can be difficult. A Business consultant in Dubai offers the research, analysis, and expertise needed to develop successful campaigns.

    Therefore, a Business consultant can provide a company with their views on a marketing campaign or project. Many professional consultants specialize in business and can offer companies the help they need.

    As a result, their expertise is perfect for any large project, as they will be able to see the big picture and help with every step of the process. The experience that a company consultant has in marketing cannot be underestimated.

    8.4 To improve results

    The future of business is no longer about just a bottom line. It is about profitability, sustainability, and growth. Companies can use the business setup consultant in dubai skills to accomplish these goals.

    Business consultants plan and execute strategies for small and medium-sized businesses to help them thrive. They bring to the table different industry-specific knowledge and experience that the business owner may not have in the company’s day-to-day operations.

    1. Do you know what are UAE free zones?

    A free zone is a region inside a nation that has been set aside as a place where companies can function with little to no taxes and minimal regulations. These locations may have different tax and duty regulations than other regions of the nation because these regulations vary from country to country. A free zone could be a territorially constrained region of a nation that provides favorable business conditions. It is possible to specifically create a free zone for manufacturing with an export focus.

    Around the UAE, there are numerous free zones that range in size and scope. Some are only a few acres in size and very tiny; while others can cover entire cities and are much larger.

    2. Know the types of Free Zones in the UAE

    Free zones come in a wide variety of forms, each with specific advantages. Let us see:

    • Special Economic Zones (SEZ): SEZs have the goal to draw in foreign investment and advance economic growth. Also, they often give firms tax advantages and other incentives.
    • Free Trade Zones (FTZ): FTZs have the objective of boosting global trade. Consequently, businesses with FTZ locations can benefit from lower tariffs and other advantages.
    • Export Processing Zones (EPZ): EPZs were established to support companies that are export-focused. An EPZ offers tax benefits and other incentives to businesses that are located there.
    • Business Zones (BZ): BZs have been created to promote many kinds of businesses. Lower fees and rent rates are just a couple of the advantages available to businesses in BZs.
    • Industrial Zones (IZ): IZs serve to boost industries like manufacturing and others. Taxes and electricity costs are lower for businesses in an IZ.

    3. Learn the benefits of business formation in free zones UAE

    Here are some advantages of business formation in a UAE free zone:

    • Tax Exemptions: Businesses in a free zone have a temporary exemption from paying taxes, giving them a competitive edge.
    • Down-cost Labor: Companies in a free zone have access to labor that is reasonably priced, which helps to keep expenses down.
    • Market Access: Companies operating in a free zone have access to both domestic and foreign markets, giving them an edge over competitors.
    • Infrastructure: Companies operating in a free zone can gain from the development of the infrastructure, which includes roads, services, and communication networks.
    • Regulatory Environment: Companies operating in free zones are subject to more benevolent regulations, which support investment.
    • Growth: By operating in a free zone, firms can reach new clientele and seize fresh chances for expansion. The free zone can also give companies a footing in a new nation or region, making it simpler for them to grow operations in the years to come.
